summary.text: Mike Croley is a Navy veteran and former federal employee who worked as a Presidential Management Fellow at NOAA on climate resilience efforts before that program was ended. He describes himself as a Navy officer, environmental engineer and former federal employee, and is the Democratic nominee for the open 6th District seat.

paragraphs.text: Croley was born in Owensboro, Kentucky, and graduated from Ohio County High School. He earned a bachelor's degree from Vanderbilt University in 2005 and a graduate degree from Tennessee Technological University in 2020.
He served in the U.S. Navy from 1999 to 2009 and later worked as a Tennessee State Park Ranger.

Croley later worked as a federal environmental engineer and Presidential Management Fellow at NOAA, with assignments across the Department of State, National Ocean Service, and U.S. Department of Agriculture.
Ballotpedia lists him as the founder of The Tranquil Path and gives his profession as nonprofit founder.
He won the August 6, 2026 Democratic primary for the 6th District, defeating Chaney Mosley, Lore Bergman, Miriam Leibowitz and Christopher Finley.
